# VanTrip Japan

> Campervan & vanlife rental service based in Fukuoka, Japan. Explore Kyushu — Japan's southern island of volcanoes, hot springs, and coastal drives — at your own pace in a fully-equipped campervan.

## Core Information

- **Website**: [https://vantripjapan.jp](https://vantripjapan.jp)
- **Booking**: [https://vantripjapan.jp/rent](https://vantripjapan.jp/rent)
- **Location**: Fukuoka, Kyushu, Japan (pickup near Fukuoka Airport)
- **Parent Company**: キャンプ女子株式会社 (Camp Jyoshi Inc.) — https://www.camjyo.com
- **Vehicles**: Compact campervans (Toyota Probox camper, Mazda Bongo camper) — sleep 1–4 people
- **Pricing**: From ¥8,000/day (seasonal rates apply)
- **Languages**: English, Japanese, Chinese, French, German
- **Support**: Email info@vantripjapan.jp / WhatsApp +81-70-9375-7129

## Why Kyushu by Campervan?

Kyushu is Japan's best-kept secret for road trips: active volcanoes (Aso, Sakurajima), world-class hot springs (Beppu, Yufuin, Kurokawa), stunning coastal drives, and far fewer tourists than Tokyo/Osaka. A campervan lets you access remote onsen, sleep at scenic Michi-no-Eki roadside stations, and explore at your own pace.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do I need a special license to drive a campervan in Japan?**
A: No — our campervans are standard passenger vehicles. You need either a valid International Driving Permit (IDP) from a Geneva Convention country, or a JAF translation if you're from Switzerland, Germany, France, Belgium, Monaco, or Taiwan.

**Q: Where can I park overnight?**
A: Michi-no-Eki (roadside stations), RV parks, and paid campsites. Our blog guides cover all the best spots in Kyushu.

**Q: What's included in the rental?**
A: Bedding, cooking equipment, portable power station, WiFi router, and full insurance. Everything you need for a road trip.

## Driving License for Japan

Drivers from Switzerland, Germany, France, Belgium, Monaco, and Taiwan need an official JAF license translation instead of an IDP. Our sister service handles this:

🚗 **[JDLTC — Japan Driver's License Translation Center](https://drive-japan-license.com/)** — Apply online from anywhere, get your translation before arriving in Japan.
